mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_transaction (sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, spec_text, order_item_id, stock_order_id, type, reason, qty, balance_after, operator_id, operator_name, remark) VALUES (#{skuId}, #{skuCode}, #{skuName}, #{specText}, #{orderItemId}, #{stockOrderId}, #{type}, #{reason}, #{qty}, #{balanceAfter}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'IN' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS in_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'OUT' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS out_qty FROM stock_transaction WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY day ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) FROM stock_transaction WHERE type = 'IN' AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) FROM stock_transaction WHERE type = 'OUT' AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT type AS type, COUNT(1) AS `count`, SUM(qty) AS qty FROM stock_transaction WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY type
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(stock), 0) FROM product_sku WHERE status = 1
